simple.meaning: יַבֶּשֶׁת (yabbesheth) is a Hebrew word meaning “dry ground.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יַבֶּשֶׁת (H3006) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 4:9, with occurrences in Exodus, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַבֶּשֶׁת (H3006) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יַבֶּשֶׁת (H3006) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יַבֶּשֶׁת (yabbesheth) / H3006 is traced through Exodus 4:9, Psalms 95:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3006. yabbesheth יַבֶּ֫שֶׁת noun feminine id., made by God's hands Psa 95:5 ; water shall become blood בַּיַּבָּ֑שֶׁת Exod 4:9 (J). יִגְאָל see below I. גאל above

occurrences.englishText: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”
The sea is his, and he made it.
